title: Allumne
description: A cozy exploration-focused modpack with beautiful biomes, stylish furniture, light RPG elements, and mild difficulty.
body:
Allumne is a refined adventure modpack centered around immersive exploration, stunning landscapes, and creative building. Journey through vibrant, hand-crafted biomes, uncover secrets across diverse dimensions, and decorate your home with an array of stylish furniture mods.

This pack offers:

🌍 Beautiful worldgen with lush biomes and unique terrain

🏡 Detailed building tools & furniture for cozy or grand homes

⚔️ Light RPG elements with gear progression and hidden threats

😈 Slightly increased difficulty to keep exploration rewarding

Whether you're a builder, wanderer, or light adventurer, Allumne offers a calm yet engaging experience—perfect solo or with friends.

🕳 Optional Add-On: Dimensional Dungeons
This modpack was designed with Dimensional Dungeons in mind.
The mod is not currently available on Modrinth, but you can download it here from CurseForge (version 1.21.1).
Simply drop the .jar into the mods/ folder after installing this pack.
